measured_cause.coordinator_hypothesis: cold journal reload at the first lookup (requirement_state.py LatestMarketSnapshotStore)
measured_cause.hypothesis_result: not the cause. In journal/dual/sqlite the store loads in __init__ (requirement_state.py:1319-1325) before uvicorn binds; with no universe state the first lookup after /readyz was 0.044-0.109 s in all three modes, with the controller readback/registry/frontier/run-scheduled calls running in parallel, and with a CPU-bound writer appending 2140 symbols per batch in the same process (max 0.115 s).
measured_cause.cause: SnapshotUniverse._last_sweep starts at 0, so the first snapshot_for_request after a start finds the hourly sweep due and runs it in its finally block (snapshot_universe.py maybe_sweep/sweep) while holding the universe lock. With an active-universe state present and most journal keys non-members, sweep -> store.withdraw_symbols (requirement_state.py:1963) -> _commit_locked (1455) -> _maybe_compact_locked (1471) -> _compact_journal_in_place (1168) re-parses the whole journal.
measured_cause.evidence: cProfile of the first snapshot_for_request: 99.9 percent cumulative in maybe_sweep -> sweep -> withdraw_symbols -> _compact_journal_in_place (profile inflates wall time ~3.5x: 74.6 s profiled). py-spy was denied permission on the VM, so the stack is the profile call tree, not a live sample.
measured_cause.scheduler_tick_question: Neither the store load nor the busy process: the scheduler tick (run via the controller HTTP calls) did not slow lookups; the wait is the in-request sweep. A real hosted tick with live connector work was not reproduced.

startup_growth: about +17 s (the sweep now runs before the port binds); 45 s is inside the compose start_period 180s (docker-compose.yml source-ingest healthcheck) and the 180 s readiness wait (36 x 5 s) of the refresh script. Healthcheck definition unchanged. A restart that has nothing to withdraw pays almost nothing.
fix: SourceIngestionRuntime._warm_snapshot_lookup() (runtime.py; snapshot_universe.py is outside the task artifact contract and unchanged) runs the first due sweep once during construction (before /readyz can answer) and sets the universe _last_sweep; runtime.snapshot_lookup_ready flag and a fixed-cost snapshot_lookup dependency in /readyz (503 while a warm start is running). Chose 'finish before ready' because the lookup already reads only the requested key; the cost was the sweep, not the read. The hourly in-request sweep is unchanged (cheap once the first one has withdrawn non-members).
script_note_for_coordinator: The script is not the cause. preflight symbols come from SOURCE_INGEST_ACTIVE_PAPER_SYMBOLS or the baseline (script lines ~2290-2300) and the lookup at ~2308 is a plain read.
